notes.title: took care of a majority of bugs
notes.notes: [p]there was an issue with depth due to the top down platforming engine. managed to find a solution the demo should be entirely glitch free in that aspect.[/p][p]the leveling system had an issue of soft locking. went back and redid all the code should be running perfectly now. [/p][p]there was an issue with loose control sticks that would have the player auto move. simple changes in the values fixed that.[/p][p]still may be some issues while in co op  battles surrounding the item menu. but runs well. [/p][p]found a few game breaking bugs made sure to fix those as well.[/p]

notes.title: local co-op added
notes.notes:
MAJOR UPDATES
this may be the first rpg to have local co-op like this. I'm not sure don't quote me on that. with the unique design of the battle system it seemed only natural the game have a co-op mode.  may be some bugs. I haven't found any yet but seems to work great. let me know if you find any and ill get it fixed.

once you've found crackhead you can toggle co-op in the options menu. a box will appear to set up the controller for player 2. may change visuals later not sure if I like it lol but it does the job.

MINOR UPDATES
bug fixes
ui updates
on the title screen you'll now get a box to connect your controller of choice. this is important for co-op and it added compatibility for most controllers. player 1 can still use the keyboard if you need to.

notes.title: small update
notes.notes:
bug fixes - fixed issue with resolution on most monitors, fixed some lighting issues

new stuff - added new button prompts for clarity, while in battle the character that's not selected now has some simple ai so he can dodge oncoming attacks automatically, enemies will now blink red to indicate they are about to attack.
